itemdesc-earmuffs: Two pads on a bent band of sticks. Worn over the ears, they take the edge off every sound, the humming of crystals included.
journal-glowingstone-page7:
A room full of humming stone wears on the ears. I made myself earmuffs: three sticks in a row across the top of the crafting grid, bent into a band, and a sheet of leather or linen under each end for the pads.

Worn in the face slot, they take a quarter off every sound I hear, the crystals, the wind and my own footsteps alike. They keep no one warm, and they never wear out.
